import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold transformed DataFrames
dfs = []

# Load each source file, select needed columns, and append to list
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Select only the columns needed for the target schema: movieId (int), rating (float)
    df_selected = df[['movieId', 'rating']].copy()
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    df_selected['movieId'] = df_selected['movieId'].astype(int)
    df_selected['rating'] = df_selected['rating'].astype(float)
    dfs.append(df_selected)

# Since there is only one source table, no union needed beyond this
# If there were multiple source tables with the same schema, we would concat here

# Concatenate all source dataframes (union)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_57/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
